# Task M-05b: the song page

**Phase:** maintenance · **Depends on:** M-05a, M-04 and M-05c (merged) · **Suggested tier:** Sonnet subagent · **Estimated size:** L

## Goal

Owner request (2026-10-10): every song has its own page, like Sonarr's episode page or Radarr's movie page, opened by clicking the song's title, with "value-adds about the song from any sources available". M-05a added the data (`GET /song/{id}`, `/song/{id}/details`, `/song/{id}/lyrics`, `songId` filters on history, queue and blocklist, and the hooks `useSong`, `useSongDetails`, `useSongLyrics`).

## Deliverables

1. **Route** `/song/:id` in `frontend/src/app/App.tsx` → `frontend/src/pages/SongPage.tsx`. A song id that does not exist shows a "Song not found" state with a link back to the Library.
2. **Links to it:** the song title in the Library table (`TitleCell`, `LibraryPage.tsx` ~101), and in Wanted (missing and cutoff unmet), Activity → Queue and History rows that show a song title. A normal link (`<Link>` / anchor, so middle-click opens a new tab); the row's existing click and selection behaviour is unchanged.
3. **Header** (the Sonarr/Radarr pattern: a band with the art on the left):
   - the album cover (album context `coverUrl`, else the details' Deezer cover, else a placeholder), the title with its version-flag badges, `Artist` (a link to `/library?artistId=…`), the album (`{albumTitle} by {albumArtist}`, track/disc, year);
   - status chips: Monitored (toggle), quality profile (select), library, Downloaded/Missing, cutoff met or not, tags;
   - actions: **Search** (automatic, the existing song search command), **Interactive search** (the existing release search, shown inline below the header like Sonarr's interactive search), **Change album**, **Convert…**, **Move…**, **Delete** — reuse the existing dialogs: move `ChangeAlbumModal` and the convert/move/delete dialogs out of `LibraryPage.tsx` into `frontend/src/components/song/` (one file each) and use them from both pages, unchanged in behaviour;
   - a 30-second **preview** player when `/api/v1/preview?songId=` has one.
4. **Tabs or sections** below the header:
   - **File:** path; quality downloaded vs on disk; codec, container, bitrate, sample rate, bit depth, channels, length, size; ReplayGain gain/peak; AcoustID with a "fingerprint verified" mark; source (Soulseek / YouTube / torrent / usenet / reference library with its name and relative path); imported at; "No file" state with the Search buttons when missing.
   - **About:** MusicBrainz (first release date, disambiguation, ISRCs, artist credit, link out), Deezer (BPM, gain, rank as a popularity figure, explicit, release date, link out), and **Appears on**: the release list from `/details` with covers and album artists (the same row look as the Change album dialog), the current album marked. Each source's block is hidden when its section is null; a source that failed never blocks the rest.
   - **Last.fm** (only when `/details` has a `lastFm` section, i.e. a key is set — M-05c): listeners and play count, tags as chips, the wiki summary with a "Read more on Last.fm" link (attribution), a short artist bio, and **Similar tracks** (up to 10; a track already in the library links to its song page, the others link to Last.fm). Without a key the block is absent, with no nag.
   - **Lyrics:** loaded only when the tab opens (`useSongLyrics(id, enabled)`); synced lyrics shown as plain lines without timestamps, with a note of the source (sidecar or LRCLIB); "No lyrics found".
   - **History:** `/history?songId=` (the History page's row look, paged).
   - **Queue & blocklist:** the song's queue items (with remove) and blocklist entries (with remove).
5. **Page title** `Artist - Title · Wondarr`; back navigation keeps the Library's filters (the Library already stores its filter in the URL — check it survives back).
6. **Docs:** `website/src/content/docs/library/managing-the-library.md` gains a "The song page" section (what is on it, how to open it). `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` → `### Added`.

## Allowed paths

- `frontend/src/**` (pages, components, app router, tests, fixtures); no change to `frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts` (regenerated in M-05a)
- `website/src/content/docs/library/managing-the-library.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`

## Constraints

- Data only through the hooks in `frontend/src/api/` (CODING_STANDARDS). Mantine components and the app's existing look; works at phone width (stacked header, no horizontal scroll).
- No backend change; if something is missing, stop and say so in the done-report.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `cd frontend && npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`; `cd website && npm ci && npm run build` — green.
2. Tests (Vitest, fixtures): the route renders header, file and about sections from fixtures; a null Deezer section hides its block; lyrics load only when the tab opens; the Library title is a link to `/song/{id}`; the moved dialogs still work from the Library page (existing tests keep passing) and open from the song page; not-found state; Search and Interactive search call the right endpoints.

## Done-report

Use the format in `docs/build/WORKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md`.
